map.一般按 DZ/T 0130 等行业规范，内检相对偏差不超过某一限值（如金等贵重元: Generally, industry standards such as DZ/T 0130 are followed: an internal test is judged qualified when the relative deviation does not exceed a given limit (stricter for precious elements such as gold). This tool only does the statistical summary; whether it is qualified must be judged against the tolerance table of the specific standard.
map.内检和外检偏差如何判合格？: How Do You Judge Internal and External Test Deviations as Qualified?
map.分析（质量/内检/外检）控制 使用指南: Analysis (Quality / Internal Test / External Test) Control Guide
map.分析（质量/内检/外检）控制工具。输入化验批次的内检、外检与整体质量数据，按工程: Analysis (quality / internal test / external test) control tool. Enter the internal test, external test, and overall quality data of a laboratory batch to assess the qualification rate of the analysis quality with engineering methods, for reference in geological laboratory quality control.
map.合格率评估：录入批次内检/外检的相对偏差或合格率，算均值与离散度判断整体质量: Qualification rate assessment: enter the relative deviation or qualification rate of the internal and external tests of a batch and compute the mean and dispersion to judge the overall quality
map.异常批次筛查：标准差偏大或极差超标的批次优先复检: Anomalous batch screening: batches with a large standard deviation or an out-of-limit range are rechecked first
map.报告归档：将统计结果作为化验质量附件随勘探报告提交: Report archiving: submit the statistical results as a laboratory quality appendix with the exploration report
map.极差仅反映极值差异，σ 与极差同时偏大才提示系统异常。建议先用本工具定位异常样品: The range only reflects the difference between extremes; only when σ and the range are both large does it indicate a systematic problem. Use this tool to locate the anomalous sample numbers first, then go back and retest the original samples rather than redoing the whole batch.
map.极差偏大是否一定重做？: Does a Large Range Always Mean Redoing the Work?
map.：例：某矿区 8 个样品的内检相对偏差（%）98, 95, 99, 97, 96: : Example: the internal test relative deviations (%) of 8 samples from a mining district are 98, 95, 99, 97, 96, 100, 94, 98, giving n=8, mean=97.13%, standard deviation σ=1.90%, range=6% (94% to 100%). The dispersion is small, so the laboratory quality of this batch is stable and the internal test qualification rate meets the standard.
map.：算法：输入一组质量指标（如内检相对偏差 %、合格率 % 等数值序列），计算 n: : Algorithm: enter a set of quality indices (such as internal test relative deviation % and qualification rate % as a numeric series) and compute n, the mean, the median, the variance, the standard deviation, the minimum, the maximum, and the range. It quickly judges whether a batch of laboratory data is stable and controllable (at least 5 samples per batch is recommended).
